operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs verify-base --offline && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm run verify
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: pause writes and scheduled maintenance work, retain exact source and private configuration, export the installation with rer export, restore into fresh empty resources with rer import, then reconcile asset history and attachment digests before resuming traffic. Preserve applied migration names and bytes.
